title: Lead-Time Commitment Share for Group Room Blocks Increases
content:
**Rider.** The commitment share of a Group Room Blocks increase is set by the lead-time share, which follows the days before arrival of the increase against the block type's rooming-list due period:

- fewer days than the rooming-list due period: **50 percent**;
- at least the rooming-list due period but fewer than the due period plus **30** days: **75 percent**;
- the due period plus 30 days or more: **100 percent**.

### Bands by block type

| Block type | Rooming-list due period (days before arrival) | 50 percent when the increase is | 75 percent when it is | 100 percent when it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Social Event Room Block | 0 | fewer than 0 days before arrival | 0 to 29 days before arrival | 30 days or more |
| Wedding Room Block | 0 | fewer than 0 days | 0 to 29 days | 30 days or more |
| Sports Team Room Block | 14 | fewer than 14 days | 14 to 43 days | 44 days or more |
| Tour & Travel Series Block | 30 | fewer than 30 days | 30 to 59 days | 60 days or more |
| Corporate Meeting Room Block | 0 | fewer than 0 days | 0 to 29 days | 30 days or more |
| Association Convention Room Block | 0 | fewer than 0 days | 0 to 29 days | 30 days or more |

### Boundary readings (hypothetical Tour & Travel Series Block increases)

| Days before arrival of the increase | Lead-time share |
|---|---|
| 29 | 50 percent |
| 30 | 75 percent |
| 59 | 75 percent |
| 60 | 100 percent |
